about: The everyday reads of a ball, for a remark on most balls (sim/ball-reads.js): the shot (timing, feet, a charge, an edge that got away), the bowling (beaten outside off, the bouncer, the yorker, the slower ball, a loose one), the players and the running. And the run-up reads of the over so far (sim/runup-reads.js), short so they're done before he lets go.
